# Area Sensor Picker & Hold Fix

Room holds now show you the sensors they found, so you can leave some out. Plus a fix for holds whose sensors were already on at startup.

### New
- **Pick sensors to leave out from the area.** After choosing an area, the next screen lists only the motion and occupancy sensors found there. Leave out anything that shouldn't count, such as your own template sensors or camera detections. If the area has no sensors yet, the screen is skipped.

### Fixed
- **Hold now runs after a restart or reload.** If a motion sensor was already on when Home Assistant started, or when a sensor joined a room hold, the hold could drop straight to clear once that sensor cleared, instead of holding for the hold time.

### Upgrade notes
- Room holds keep the sensors you already left out. Edit a hold to see the new picker.
- Requires Home Assistant 2025.3 or later. Automated tests run on Home Assistant 2026.2.
- Update from **Settings → Updates**, then restart Home Assistant. If new options show raw names such as `latch_trigger`, restart Home Assistant, then in the Companion app use **Settings → Companion app → Troubleshooting → Reset frontend cache**.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sambarlick/Hold-Latch/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0
